Author: Valenth Siveria
Name: BlackJack Buttler
Punchline: Good evening. I'm your BlackJack Buttler - quietly tracking the table and offering the right hint at the right time.
Changelog:
v1.8.4.2 — Changes since v1.8.4.0

ALLIANCE SUPPORT:
- Full alliance support is always active: one dealer can manage up to 23 players
- Party/alliance members are synchronized automatically
- Party chat and group /dice commands route to alliance chat while an alliance is active
- Added Alliance settings, Nearby J configuration, and an Alliance Invite custom-command creator

NEW:
- Added Version 2 Compact view, /skip, Payout command selections, session-only Allow 0 bet, preset creators, stacked preset previews, <dealerHand>, tip buttons, Open Changelog, and Full Debug tracing
- Added live User Statistics with per-player traded-in, paid-out, and profit/loss totals
- Group Detector startup can create a new User Statistics file or continue the current one without duplicate players
- User Statistics sessions can be reviewed or exported after Group Detector stops

CHANGED:
- Preset previews now simulate dealer draw, player draw, player state, stand, rule-based dealer turns, and the final result
- Full player names and color-coded aliases with double-click editing
- Thousands-separated Bank/Bet inputs with orange invalid-bet text
- Removed Alias and Bank/Bet +/- columns; reorganized header controls
- Own Buttons moved into Commands, Variables into DEBUG, and Round History into Stats
- Regex and preset editing workflows were reorganized

FIXED:
- Removed stale players after leaving, disbanding, and Group Detector toggles through strict group validation
- Fixed queued actions, round starts, Bank Tell, and Bet Change main-thread execution
- Fixed zero-bet round starts, empty /skip result rows, and alliance /dice routing
- Fixed Classic table alignment, settings labels, and Debug player generation
- Expanded diagnostics for blocked, stale, skipped, rejected, and failed actions
